synthesis.trait: Nurturing caretaker who looks out for her friends and their animals' well-being
Playful, mischievous, competitive troublemaker who initiates games and dares among friends
Genuine fear/vulnerability surfaces beneath her playful exterior when confronted with real danger

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Playful, mischievous, competitive troublemaker who initiates games and dares among friends
turning_points.what_changes: The text explicitly states 'her mischief falls from her face' -- a precise, concrete reversal of the exact playful/mischievous quality established when she broke into a gallop teasing the others, now stripped away by real danger.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Genuine fear/vulnerability surfaces beneath her playful exterior when confronted with real danger
turning_points.what_changes: The danger she spotted in the previous beat materializes without a gap: her own scream is heard, cut off suddenly as if by force, the direct unbroken continuation of the threat she reacted to.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Genuine fear/vulnerability surfaces beneath her playful exterior when confronted with real danger
turning_points.what_changes: The abduction implied by her cut-off scream is now shown realized: she is bound, blindfolded, and trembling as a captive, a further exposed limit -- total physical helplessness -- beyond the earlier fear reaction alone.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Genuine fear/vulnerability surfaces beneath her playful exterior when confronted with real danger
turning_points.what_changes: She moves from passive trembling captivity to actively, physically struggling as her head is held underwater -- a clear escalation from passive fear to active resistance never previously shown.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Genuine fear/vulnerability surfaces beneath her playful exterior when confronted with real danger
turning_points.what_changes: The same drowning struggle continues without a break: she is lifted and immediately screams for help, the direct extension of her fight for survival begun in the prior beat.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Genuine fear/vulnerability surfaces beneath her playful exterior when confronted with real danger
turning_points.what_changes: Her resistance escalates past screaming and struggling to physically beginning to overpower her attacker -- the greatest scale of active resistance yet -- before being repeatedly struck and forced under again, exposing the limit of her strength against Trudy's violence.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Genuine fear/vulnerability surfaces beneath her playful exterior when confronted with real danger
turning_points.what_changes: The same physical struggle continues to its end without a gap: her resistance finally leaves her entirely and she goes lifeless, the ultimate and final limit of the fight for survival begun earlier.
